title: Do not resubmit the login form while waiting for a verification code
symptom: The user sent the code, but entering it shows Invalid OTP
cause: Resubmitting the login sends a new code and invalidates the previous one
fix: Do not resubmit the form while waiting for the code
First check with web text that the OTP screen is showing
If you already resubmitted, ask the user for the new code
